name: LinkedIn Recruiter: advanced-search FACET probe (read-only, no search)
description: Diagnostic. Opens ONE advanced-search facet and reports its real expanded DOM — control inventory (inputs/selects/buttons with their data-test attributes and <select> options) plus trimmed outerHTML — so a new facet can be automated from evidence instead of guessed selectors. Written because the saved snapshots only ever captured facets COLLAPSED, so the expanded controls (typeahead input, must-have/can-have mode, proficiency dropdown) exist nowhere offline. With type_text it types a value and reports the typeahead suggestions; with select=true it also commits the exact match, so controls that only appear once a value is added get captured. Nothing is persisted: facet state is client-side until "Run search", which this workflow never clicks. Params: facet (a data-test suffix like "spoken-languages", or a full CSS selector), type_text, select.

steps.intent: Probe the facet (read-only — never runs the search)
